traits.name: Fire Absorption
traits.text:
Whenever the brass man is subjected to fire damage, it
takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the
fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text:
The brass man is immune to any spell or effect that
would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The brass man has advantage on saving throws against
spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The brass man’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The brass man makes two greatsword attack and one slam
attack.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target.
Hit: 18 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18
(3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Molten Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text:
The brass man exhales molten brass in a
25-foot line. Each creature along that line must make a DC 13 Dexterity
saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much
on a successful one.
